definitions.text_en: one (cardinal numeral 1); single unit or individual
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika unità waħda jew individwu wieħed.

usage_examples.mt: Hemm student wieħed biss fil-klassi dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: There is only one student in the class this morning.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika par jew żewġ unitajiet; jiġi wara l-wieħed u qabel it-tlieta.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi tnejn minn dawk il-kotba fuq l-ixkaffa.
usage_examples.en: I have two of those books on the shelf.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' tliet unitajiet; jiġi wara t-tnejn u qabel l-erbgħa.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm tlieta min-nies jistennew quddiem il-bieb.
usage_examples.en: There were three people waiting in front of the door.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' erba' unitajiet; jiġi wara t-tlieta u qabel il-ħamsa.

usage_examples.mt: Xtara erbgħa minnhom biex iqassamhom lil sħabu.
usage_examples.en: He bought four of them to distribute to his friends.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' ħames unitajiet; jiġi wara l-erbgħa u qabel is-sitta.

usage_examples.en: Only five of them remain in the box.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' sitt unitajiet; jiġi wara l-ħamsa u qabel is-sebgħa.

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal kollha kienu sitta b'kollox fil-grupp.
usage_examples.en: The children were six in all in the group.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għadd ta' tmien unitajiet; jiġi wara s-sebgħa u qabel id-disgħa.

usage_examples.en: Eight of them arrived on time for the meeting.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika żewġ għaxriet jew 20 unità; jiġi wara d-dsatax u qabel il-wieħed u għoxrin.

usage_examples.mt: Għalaq għoxrin sena nhar il-Ħadd li għadda.
usage_examples.en: He turned twenty years old last Sunday.

definitions.text_en: hundred (cardinal numeral 100); combining form before nouns
definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għaxar għaxriet jew 100 unità quddiem nom; forma komposta ta' mija.

usage_examples.mt: Għex aktar minn mitt sena b'saħħa tajba.
usage_examples.en: He lived more than a hundred years in good health.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika għaxar mijiet jew 1,000 unità.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kuntratt jiswa aktar minn elf ewro.
usage_examples.en: The contract is worth more than a thousand euros.

definitions.text_mt: Numru kardinali u ċifra li tindika elf elf jew 1,000,000 unità.

usage_examples.mt: Inġabru aktar minn miljun ewro b'risq dawk fil-bżonn.
usage_examples.en: More than a million euros were collected for those in need.

definitions.text_en: first (ordinal numeral); initial, foremost in order or series
definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni tal-bidu jew li jiġi qabel kull ħaġa oħra f'ordni, grad jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien l-ewwel student li wasal fl-iskola dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: He was the first student who arrived at school this morning.

definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara l-ewwel u qabel it-tielet.

usage_examples.mt: Fit-tieni kapitlu tal-ktieb jiddiskuti t-tibdil fil-klima.
usage_examples.en: In the second chapter of the book he discusses climate change.

definitions.text_mt: Numru ordinali li jindika l-pożizzjoni li tiġi minnufih wara t-tieni u qabel ir-raba'.

usage_examples.en: He finished in third place in the national competition.

definitions.text_en: half (fraction of one half); equal part of a whole
definitions.text_mt: Frazzjoni u kwantità li tindika parti waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

definitions.text_en: middle, midpoint; central point in space or time
definitions.text_mt: Il-punt ċentrali jew il-mument tan-nofs bejn żewġ limiti fi spazju jew fi żmien.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa nofs il-ħobża u ħalla l-kumplament għal għada.
usage_examples.en: He took half of the loaf of bread and left the rest for tomorrow.
